mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of future corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 compared to baseline returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 9.0% over a 3-month window signals improving labor market conditions, which increases consumer confidence and spending, leading to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in instances where UNRATE falls below 9.0% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which boosts corporate sales and earnings expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 85.0 over two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals economic distress and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 85.0 for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real GDP growth (GDPC1) from a contractionary base to positive growth over a 3-month window signals a recovery in aggregate demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate turns positive after two consecutive negative quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where GDPC1 turns positive after two negative quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% over three consecutive months, combined with a stagnant federal funds rate, signals that monetary policy is lagging behind inflation, increasing real interest rate uncertainty and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.5% for 3 consecutive months AND FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% for 3 months and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and a rise in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market recovery, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 for three consecutive months, combined with a decline in residential construction (HOUST), indicates a broad-based supply-side contraction, which raises recession risks and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 90.0 and HOUST < 480.0 for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).
